stepAnswer: Use LASSO regression to predict Y from X.
stepBody: Suppose Jessica has a design matrix X with an unknown number of rows and features and a target variable Y which stores the data in the food column.\n\nJessica wants to have unimportant features of X have a corresponding weight more likely set to $$0$$. What should Jessica do?
choices: Use OLS to predict Y from X.
Use LASSO regression to predict Y from X.
Use ridge regression to predict Y from X.
Use a constant model to predict Y from X.
Use a $$higher-degree$$ polynomial model to predict Y from X.
